title: Code Bubbles: Rethinking the User Interface Paradigm of Integrated Development Environments
summary: A short demo of Code Bubbles, an IDE interface built around editable code fragments in bubbles instead of files. It was a research prototype for Java development.
why: HN keeps returning to it as the most convincing example of moving past file-based code editing, even though it never left prototype stage.

quote.text: Code Bubbles (from 2010) is the most convincing code visualization tool that I can recall
